reserve_profile.summary: sUSDe vault shares are backed by USDe deposited into Ethena's staking contract. The deposited USDe is not separately rehypothecated by the vault; its broader economic backing remains the USDe system.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: sUSDe holders using supported contracts or interfaces, subject to protocol and access conditions.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Protocol cooldown, reward, and network conditions may apply; no fixed fiat redemption is provided by sUSDe itself.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: Protocol cooldown and onchain settlement dependent.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Ethena front-end and terms restrictions may apply.
Sanctions and regional access controls may apply.

reserve_profile.summary: sDAI represents shares in a DAI savings vault and is economically dependent on DAI and the Maker/Sky savings-rate mechanism.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: sDAI holders using the deployed vault contract or compatible interfaces.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Network costs apply; the legacy route may not be exposed by current first-party interfaces.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Current first-party interface support is limited.
Direct contract or third-party access may be required.

reserve_profile.summary: sUSDS represents ERC-4626 vault shares backed by deposited USDS and depends on the broader Sky Protocol collateral and accounting system.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Users of the sUSDS ERC-4626 vault, subject to supported interfaces and access restrictions.
redemption_profile.fee_text: The documented vault route assesses no protocol fee; network costs apply.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Sky front-end screening and regional restrictions may apply.

reserve_profile.summary: Depending on issuance date, USDY may be secured by short-term U.S. Treasuries, short-duration U.S. Treasury ETF shares, or bank demand deposits.

redemption_profile.settlement_asset: USD or supported settlement assets under the offering terms
redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Qualifying onboarded non-US investors; professional or qualified-investor restrictions apply in some jurisdictions.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Subscription, redemption, network, and offering-specific costs may apply.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Professional or qualified-investor requirements apply in certain jurisdictions.

reserve_profile.summary: Each USYC token represents a share of the Hashnote International Short Duration Yield Fund, whose portfolio primarily uses short-term U.S. Treasury and reverse-repo exposures.

redemption_profile.eligible_parties: Onboarded, KYC/AML-approved, allowlisted non-US institutional investors.
redemption_profile.minimum_amount_text: Typically US$100,000, subject to current fund and Circle terms.
redemption_profile.fee_text: Subscription and redemption fee waivers or charges depend on daily volume, route, and liquidity terms.
redemption_profile.settlement_time_text: T+0 or near-real-time under ordinary conditions; larger redemptions may settle T+0 or T+1.
jurisdiction_restrictions: Available only to non-US persons under Regulation S.
Institutional onboarding, KYC/AML, and wallet allowlisting are required.
